header: CN 111440099 B    权　利　要　求　书    1/1 页

paragraphs.zh:
1.一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法，方法包括以下步骤：
1）将环磺酮产品溶解在含水溶液中，升温；
2）加入吸附剂，进行保温、热过滤；
3）控温调节含水溶液pH至3以下，降温、从溶液中结晶出纯化的环磺酮；
所述步骤1）中所述含水溶液，为乙腈、甲醇、乙醇、二甲基甲酰胺与水混合得到的溶液；所述含水溶液中含水量为20%～40%；所述升温，是将温度升至30℃～60℃；
步骤2）中所述保温的时间在0.2h～1h；
所述吸附剂为活性炭或硅藻土。
paragraphs.notes: Claims on this page carry no [00NN] paragraph markers, so the printed claim number is used as the marker: this is claim 1. The numbered sub-steps are printed with a full-width closing bracket after each digit and are kept exactly as printed inside the zh text; the seven printed sub-paragraphs of claim 1 are joined with newlines, while lines that are only print wraps of a single sub-paragraph are joined with no separator. Chemically ambiguous: the solvent list is separated by the Chinese enumeration comma, so the text does not say whether the aqueous solution is any one of acetonitrile, methanol, ethanol or dimethylformamide mixed with water, or all four mixed together with water. Translated literally; the reading is not resolved here.

paragraphs.zh: 2.根据权利要求1所述的环磺酮产品的纯化方法，其特征在于，步骤3）所述控温调节含水溶液pH至3以下的步骤，包括，将含水溶液中加入盐酸调节pH至3以下。
paragraphs.en: 2. The method for purifying a tembotrione product according to claim 1, characterised in that the step in step 3) of adjusting, under temperature control, the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 comprises adding hydrochloric acid to the aqueous solution to adjust the pH to below 3.
paragraphs.notes: Marker is the printed claim number, claim 2. The two printed lines are wraps of one paragraph and are joined with no separator, because the wrap falls in the middle of a word (the last character of the first printed line and the first character of the second belong to the same word).

paragraphs.zh: 3.根据权利要求1所述的环磺酮产品的纯化方法，其特征在于，所述步骤3）中，搅拌速度在150转至200转。
paragraphs.en: 3. The method for purifying a tembotrione product according to claim 1, characterised in that in step 3) the stirring speed is from 150 revolutions to 200 revolutions.
paragraphs.notes: Marker is the printed claim number, claim 3. The two printed lines are wraps of one paragraph and are joined with no separator, because the wrap falls in the middle of the word for stirring speed. The page states the stirring speed only in revolutions and prints no per-minute time base, so none is supplied here.
